user.description: Enter the air conditioner's LAN IP address. Default port 56800 (first-generation eSDK Wi-Fi module). Nothing goes to the cloud.

init.title: Options
init.description: Changing the IP or port is verified with a live connection first; an unreachable address will not be saved. Keep the poll interval at 10 seconds or more (the module accepts only one TCP connection at a time). With auto-rediscover enabled, a new DHCP address is found again by scanning the local subnet for the module MAC.
